def select_next_node(current_node: int, destination_node: int, unvisited_nodes: np.ndarray, distance_matrix: np.ndarray) -> int:
    """Select the next node to visit in a TSP greedy construction.

    Args:
        current_node: ID of the current node
        destination_node: ID of the destination (return) node
        unvisited_nodes: array of unvisited node IDs
        distance_matrix: pairwise distance matrix between all nodes
    Returns:
        next_node: ID of the next node to visit
    """
    n_remaining = len(unvisited_nodes)
    # distances from current node to all unvisited nodes
    dist_curr = distance_matrix[current_node, unvisited_nodes]
    # distances from each unvisited node to the destination node
    dist_dest = distance_matrix[unvisited_nodes, destination_node]
    # adaptive weight: higher when few nodes left
    weight = 1.0 / (n_remaining + 1)
    # combined score
    scores = dist_curr + weight * dist_dest
    # select node with minimum score
    return unvisited_nodes[np.argmin(scores)]

import numpy as np

def select_next_node(current_node: int, destination_node: int, unvisited_nodes: np.ndarray, distance_matrix: np.ndarray) -> int:
    n_unvisited = len(unvisited_nodes)
    if n_unvisited == 0:
        return destination_node
    # Compute scores: distance to current + (distance to destination) / remaining nodes
    scores = distance_matrix[current_node][unvisited_nodes] + distance_matrix[unvisited_nodes][:, destination_node] / n_unvisited
    best_idx = np.argmin(scores)
    return unvisited_nodes[best_idx]

def select_next_node(current_node: int, destination_node: int, unvisited_nodes: np.ndarray, distance_matrix: np.ndarray) -> int:
    """Select the next node to visit in a TSP greedy construction.

    Args:
        current_node: ID of the current node
        destination_node: ID of the destination (return) node
        unvisited_nodes: array of unvisited node IDs
        distance_matrix: pairwise distance matrix between all nodes
    Returns:
        next_node: ID of the next node to visit
    """
    # Compute distances from current node to each unvisited node
    d_from_curr = distance_matrix[current_node][unvisited_nodes]
    # Compute distances from each unvisited node to the destination node
    d_to_dest = distance_matrix[unvisited_nodes, destination_node]
    # Product heuristic
    scores = d_from_curr * d_to_dest
    best_index = np.argmin(scores)
    return unvisited_nodes[best_index]

def select_next_node(current_node: int, destination_node: int, unvisited_nodes: np.ndarray, distance_matrix: np.ndarray) -> int:
    n_remaining = len(unvisited_nodes)
    total_nodes = distance_matrix.shape[0]
    # dynamic weight: when many nodes left, favor immediate distance; when few, favor return
    alpha = 0.3 if n_remaining > total_nodes // 2 else 0.7
    # distances from current to candidates
    curr_dist = distance_matrix[current_node, unvisited_nodes]
    # distances from candidates to destination
    dest_dist = distance_matrix[unvisited_nodes, destination_node]
    combined = curr_dist + alpha * dest_dist
    next_node = unvisited_nodes[np.argmin(combined)]
    return next_node

def select_next_node(current_node: int, destination_node: int, unvisited_nodes: np.ndarray, distance_matrix: np.ndarray) -> int:
    """Select the next node to visit in a TSP greedy construction.

    Args:
        current_node: ID of the current node
        destination_node: ID of the destination (return) node
        unvisited_nodes: array of unvisited node IDs
        distance_matrix: pairwise distance matrix between all nodes
    Returns:
        next_node: ID of the next node to visit
    """
    if len(unvisited_nodes) == 1:
        return unvisited_nodes[0]
    
    best_score = np.inf
    best_node = None
    eps = 1e-10
    
    for cand in unvisited_nodes:
        d1 = distance_matrix[current_node, cand]
        # compute minimum distance from cand to any other unvisited node
        other_unvisited = unvisited_nodes[unvisited_nodes != cand]
        if len(other_unvisited) == 0:
            d2 = 1.0 / eps  # large value when no other unvisited
        else:
            d2 = np.min(distance_matrix[cand, other_unvisited])
        score = d1 * (1.0 + 1.0 / (d2 + eps))
        if score < best_score:
            best_score = score
            best_node = cand
    return best_node
